title: 四月油价120撑住了：现在油价加收益率5%，AI权益资产还能撑住吗
speaker: Gareth Nicholson

segments.en: Maybe just a little thesis for viewers just joining us right now. You know, the AI equity trade held up amidst oil at 110, 120 back in April. But we didn't have US yields at 5% then.
segments.zh: 也许给刚加入的观众一个小论点。你知道，AI权益资产交易在4月油价110、120时保持住了。但那时我们没有美国收益率在5%。

segments.en: Now, you have a combination of those two things. Now, what does the equity market outlook like if oil holds and yields hold at these levels?
segments.zh: 现在，你有这两件事的组合。现在，如果油价和收益率保持在这些水平，权益市场前景如何？

segments.en: David, really, the question that equity is, can the equity market still sustain this growth rate, this return that they're seeing, with rates growing up, 25, 50, even 75, which is not a base case.
segments.zh: David，实际上，权益的问题是，权益市场能否仍然维持这种增长率，他们看到的这种回报，随着利率上升25、50甚至75个基点，这不是基准情形。

segments.en: But let's say we even push it up to 1%. The growth projections for the equity market, particularly the AI sector, I don't think 1% is going to materially change that.
segments.zh: 但假设我们甚至推到1%。权益市场的增长预测，特别是AI板块，我不认为1%会实质性改变这一点。

segments.en: So yes, there's going to be a headline risk. Yes, there's going to be more expenses on the funding of all these big projects. But I think from an equity analyst, a 1% increase on cost isn't the biggest problem they have.
segments.zh: 所以是的，会有头条风险。是的，所有这些大项目的融资会有更多费用。但我认为从权益分析师的角度，成本增加1%不是他们最大的问题。

segments.en: They've got other things they're going to keep an eye on. They're going to see how they're spending money, what kind of capital promises are coming through. But generally speaking, we still see demand for AI. It's now just choosing where in the AI growing story you want to be,
segments.zh: 他们还有其他事情要关注。他们会看如何花钱，什么样的资本承诺正在兑现。但一般来说，我们仍然看到对AI的需求。现在只是选择你想在AI增长故事的哪个位置，

segments.en: which geographics, which sectors within AI. So I think it's something markets are going to watch very closely as yields continue to creep up higher, but financial earnings are still going to be okay.
segments.zh: 哪些地理区域，AI内的哪些板块。所以我认为这是市场将密切关注的事情，随着收益率继续攀升，但财务盈利仍然会不错。
